ops.text: spawnllm ClaudeCliBackend (claude -p --model haiku) failed 20/20 calls in bench/confirm.py with '401 OAuth access token has expired': it seeds an isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR from the stored credentials file/keychain entry and never refreshes the token, while live Claude sessions refresh their own. Any capt-hook LLM call routed to the claude CLI backend fails the same way until the stored token is refreshed. Fix belongs in spawnllm's claude_isolation (refresh or reuse CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN).
